events.description: Opinion issued by court as to Appellant Secretary of State for the State of Alabama in 25-13007, 25-14131. Decision: Vacated and Remanded. Opinion type: Non-Published. Opinion method: Per Curiam. Motion to vacate lower court order filed by Appellees Greater Birmingham Ministries, Alabama State Conference of the NAACP and Evan Milligan is DENIED as MOOT. [10751434-2] in 25-13007, Motion to vacate lower court order filed by Appellees Greater Birmingham Ministries, Evan Milligan and Alabama State Conference of the NAACP is DENIED as MOOT. [10751438-2] in 25-14131; Motion to remand in full filed by Appellees Greater Birmingham Ministries, Alabama State Conference of the NAACP and Evan Milligan is DENIED as MOOT. [10751434-3] in 25-13007, Motion to remand in full filed by Appellees Greater Birmingham Ministries, Evan Milligan and Alabama State Conference of the NAACP is DENIED as MOOT. [10751438-3] in 25-14131. (See 06/08/2026 opinion)(ELB/RJL/NGA) The opinion is also available through the Court's Opinions page at this link http://www.ca11.uscourts.gov/opinions . [25-13007, 25-14131]
